attchmntText: Kesoram Industries Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Voting Result along with Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot.
voiceSummary: Kesoram Industries Limited reports that members approved six resolutions via postal ballot on November 11, 2026. The e-voting period ran from October 13, 2026, to November 11, 2026. Scrutinizer Ritu Bajaj submitted her report on November 11, 2026. The resolutions passed include the appointment of Mr. Aninda Chatterjee, DIN 01760865, as Independent Director. Mr. Himanshu Ranjan, DIN 10950872, was appointed as Independent Director. Mr. Rishi Bajoria, DIN 00501157, was appointed as Independent Director. Mrs. Charu Rajgharia, DIN 05329700, was appointed as Independent Director. Mr. Amit Agarwalla, DIN 00413345, was appointed as Non-Executive Non-Independent Director. Mr. Gautam Agarwalla, DIN 00413204, was appointed as Managing Director. The results are available on the company website and NSDL.

attchmntText: Kesoram Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Kesoram Industries Limited approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net profit was 4,875.74 lakhs, compared to a loss of 11,186.03 lakhs in the previous year. Consolidated net profit was 3,258.61 lakhs, versus a loss of 12,529.99 lakhs previously. Standalone revenue from operations was nil. Consolidated revenue from operations was 8,448.75 lakhs for the quarter. Standalone basic EPS was 1.57. Consolidated basic EPS was 1.05. The Board meeting concluded at 2:20 p.m. on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Kesoram Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ''.
voiceSummary: Kesoram Industries Limited received an Arbitral Award dated 09th November, 2026, in its favor against Kesoram Textile Mills Limited regarding an outstanding loan. The award determines the receivable amount at Rs. 5,989.35 Lakhs, comprising principal of Rs. 955 Lakhs and accrued interest of Rs. 5,034.35 Lakhs. The company had initially claimed Rs. 9,242.71 Lakhs. The arbitrator was Mr. Santanu Jha, Retired District Judge. Kesoram Industries Limited will take necessary steps for enforcement and recovery of the awarded amount in accordance with applicable laws. The actual recovery remains subject to the enforcement of the Arbitral Award. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations.
